title: GrantThai validation rule catalog (validators/rules.yaml)
description: Draft. Rules are data; src/grantthai/validators implements them. Severity vocabulary is BLOCK / REVIEW / INFO everywhere (rules, validation reports, validation_summary in the output frontmatter).

id.description: Rule id. The 7SSA structure-profile rules use the form 7SSA-NN (family SSA).

routes.description: v0.3 router: the output routes (routes/INDEX.yaml ids) this rule is evaluated for, or the literal 'all'. Absent means 'all'. The engine evaluates a rule only if its family is in the route's include_families, its id is not in exclude_ids and this list names the route or 'all'; rules outside a route's scope are reported once as INFO RT002, never silently skipped. A route is chosen by a person, never by an AI.

derived_from.description: docs/practice/funded-work-patterns.md = a practice pattern shared by funded final reports (corpus-100; for the ART family these are final reports, not articles, and the locator says so); docs/policy/ai-use-ceiling.md = GrantThai's AI-use ceiling, built on the national GenAI research-ethics guideline (September 2569), which is guidance whose binding status is OPEN. A rule from either source is REVIEW or INFO only, never BLOCK; its locator cites the guideline page. AGENTS.md = one of GrantThai's own non-negotiables (the locator names which); the only non-package source a BLOCK may rest on (ART007). 7ssa/v1@sha256:<hex> = the founder-authored 7SSA master schema v1.0 (a structure architecture, not a venue or funder document); a rule from it is REVIEW or INFO only, never BLOCK, and fires only while a 7SSA structure profile is selected.

negative_fixture.description: Where the rule's negative case lives: a real fixture directory (a BLOCK rule that ships in v0.1 and is evaluated by this build), a 'test:<path>::<function>' pointer to the pytest function that exercises it (a REVIEW/INFO rule that v0.1 evaluates but does not get its own fixture directory), or the literal 'not_evaluated_in_v0.1' (a rule this build does not evaluate at all, per grantthai.validators.engine.V01_NOT_EVALUATED or ships != v0.1).
